title: Coppore
description: Makes every ore copper [except redstone :( Idk why it doesn't work]
body:
![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8806228fe89923f0a2ea861f7d02e5b97012040c.png)

### _Hehe_

This is a joke texture pack created to confuse your friends. It is supposed to make **all** the ores into copper, but for _SOME GODFORSAKEN REASON_, Redstone ore _really_ doesn't want to change. I looked everywhere, but I cannot for the life of me change its texture. (I mean, I _did_ change its texture, it's just that it **doesn't** change the way redstone looks _ingame_.)

But thankfully, all the other ores have changed into copper.

The main purpose of this resource pack is to prank your friends or family by installing this without their knowledge and laugh when they only see copper in the caves. Although in The Copper Age update, copper finally stopped being useless, this pack is still _kinda_ funny because _you never know what you're mining!_

## **This pack is in development**
This pack is not fully finished (because of the redstone ore thing), so there are probably some spelling mistakes and bugs. There aren't many features and the features that _are_ in the pack are not very polished. Do not have high expectations.

**This pack will be finished as soon as I figure out how to turn redstone into copper.**

_At least Mumbo jumbo will be happy!_


<details>
<summary>Additions</summary>
  
- Changed the texture of all the ores to become copper
- Changed the names of the ores
</details>



Hope you _enjoy_ ;)
